# Brain Update Log

## 2026-08-21

* **Skill: `code-review`.** New Cursor skill + command + Copilot prompt (`.github/skills/code-review/` is generated by `tools/sync_skills.py`) for reviewing a diff, branch, or PR. Procedure lives in the skill; the law lives in two new standards so both are packable and separately citable:
  * `standards/code-review.md` — the bar ("approve when it improves overall code health, not when it is perfect"), ≤200/400 LOC sizing, ≤1 business day first response, the ten review dimensions in priority order (design → blast radius/rollback → … → observability/cost), a Conventional Comments protocol with `(blocking)` opt-in, and the `Approved | Manual Intervention | Blocked` decision. Sourced from `google/eng-practices` (~21k★, CC-BY 3.0), `thoughtbot/guides` (~10k★), and conventionalcomments.org.
  * `standards/code-quality-gates.md` — the machine half, so review does not spend itself on things a linter decides: the fmt → lint → secret scan → policy scan → tests → change-preview ladder as required CI checks, plus per-stack checks for Terraform (attach the `plan`, watch `-/+` destroys, `prevent_destroy`), Kubernetes/Helm, containers, GitHub Actions (`permissions: {}`, 40-char SHA pins, privileged triggers, untrusted input via `env:`, OIDC), shell, Python, and Go.
  * Split rationale: the two cards are consumed at different times (gates at author/CI time, the bar at review time) and merging them would blow the ~600-char card budget, diluting both.
* **Layout:** restored `kernel/` as the tooling folder — CLI is `_okf_knowledge/kernel/okf.py`, package is `_okf_knowledge/kernel/okf/`. Brain artifacts stay at `_okf_knowledge/` root. Folder name `kernel` is the zone; package import remains `okf` (no `kernel_` variable prefixes).
* **Standard:** `standards/python-naming.md` is binding for the runtime package — one style per identifier (`lower_snake` / `UPPER_SNAKE` / `CapWords` only). `okf.py lint` enforces it via AST (`DBG-320` style, `DBG-321` banned `okf_`/`kernel_` prefixes). Headers stay in `metadata-headers.md` and point here for naming.
* **Layout + naming:** `kernel/` is the tooling folder (CLI + package). Dropped `KERNEL_*` / `kernel_*` *identifiers* (folder name kept). Constants stay `UPPER_SNAKE`; locals/params `lower_snake`; HTML/file headers use `file_name` / `description` / `version` / `authors` (not `FILE_NAME`). `python3 -m okf` runs from `kernel/`.
* **Naming:** dropped the `okf_` / `OKF_` prefix on identifiers (`BRAIN_HTML`, `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, `load_config`, `inject_into_brain`, `STATUS_VALUES`, feature flags `compile`/`lint`, log tags `[pack]`/`[lookup]`, XML `<prompt_pack>`). Env override is `VAULT_ROOT` (was `OKF_VAULT_ROOT`). Schema field `okf_version` and on-disk names (`.okfignore`, package path) unchanged.
* **Package shape:** importable package `okf/` (not a folder literally called `src`). Visualizer at `okf/assets/brain.html`. Compile artifacts at brain root. `pyproject.toml` name `okf`.
* **Rename:** dropped the `_cmd` suffix on modules (`pack_cmd.py` → `pack.py`, same for `compile`, `lint`, `scrape`, `serve`, `tokens`, `optimize`, `capabilities`). Feature flag `okf_v02` → `nested_yaml`.
* **Token floor:** cut `AGENTS.md` to a stub (~Rule #1 + pointers). Unverified is now a **silent** pack default — only `machine-confirmed` and stale cards pay for a `trust:` line (an all-unverified vault was taxing every pack with useless labels).
* **Domain seed:** added `vault/systems/okf-kernel.md` — the runnable CLI this package actually ships — so packs for compile/lint/serve/scrape can return non-meta cards.
* **House schema Prompt Card** no longer teaches `timestamp` as current practice.
* **Adopted OKF.** The spec had moved from v0.1 to v0.2 while this system claimed `okf_version: "0.1"`, and the kernel could not parse nested frontmatter at all: its provenance, trust, and computation families are nested maps (`generated: {by, at}`, `sources: [{id, resource}]`), which the hand-rolled YAML subset rejects outright — a consumer behaviour §4.1 forbids. `parse_frontmatter` now uses PyYAML when importable and keeps the subset as a declared-degraded fallback; `capabilities` reports which path is live.
* **Fix (portability):** PyYAML immediately rejected `standards/ide-context-guardrails.md`. `pack_force_when: [@workspace, …]` is invalid YAML — `@` is a reserved indicator — and the subset parser had been silently accepting it for months. Any conformant consumer would have dropped that document. Now quoted.
* **Conformance:** `status: active` → `stable` (§5.4 enum is `draft | stable | deprecated`); `timestamp` → `generated: { by, at }` (§13.1 breaking change); `log.md` date headings restored to bare ISO 8601 (§9 `MUST`, and a conformance criterion under §11.3) — the parenthetical suffixes below were the violation; `okf_version` → `"0.2"`.
* **Trust:** lint gates the provenance/trust/lifecycle families. Pack used to label every card `trust: unverified`, which only ever reported bad news and burned tokens; unverified is now silent, and only `machine-confirmed` / stale cards get a `trust:` line. Human sign-off on the binding standards is still outstanding (`human:<you>`), which is why DBG-317 INFO remains.
* **Fix:** `scrape` emits the `sources` frontmatter family instead of the v0.1 `# Citations` body list.

* **Traversal — cards now carry their graph edges.** `compile` built a 9-node / 25-edge graph, but the edges were used only as a ±4/±2 ranking nudge and then **stripped**: every Prompt Card contained zero links, and the house schema mandated it ("no link lists"). The agent received top-k text ranked by lexical similarity with no relationships — structurally RAG, which is the thing OKF exists to replace. `pack` now appends a `related:` line per card listing neighbours **not already in the pack**, capped at 3 (`related_links` in `okf/config.py`, `0` disables). Footers are attached after card selection, so traversal never displaces a card or breaks `--budget`. Cost is ~8 tokens per link (+13–33% per pack, measured). An empty pack now also names `_okf_knowledge/index.md` as the browse-by-hand entry point — the spec's progressive-disclosure convention, which no code path had been reading.
* **`resource` — the missing reserved field.** OKF v0.1 reserves `type`, `title`, `description`, `tags`, and `resource`; the house schema implemented every one except `resource`, and `scrape` buried the fetched URL in body prose under a bespoke `source_url` key. `resource` is now first-class: parsed, carried through `index.json`, surfaced as a `source:` line on cards, and written by `scrape`. Lint gained `DBG-310` (value is not a URL or vault-absolute path) and `DBG-311` (`Reference` without a source). `source_url` is gone.

* Deliberately **not** changed: the agent keeps the name OKF despite colliding with Google's vendor-neutral spec, and the runtime stays mandatory for non-trivial work — so the bundle is portable as data but the workflow is not. Both are accepted trade-offs, not oversights.
* **Rebrand: Aegis → OKF.** Complete, across filenames, directories, commands, code symbols, and prose. The agent/protocol is now **OKF**; the repository directory `aegis-system` is the only name deliberately preserved, along with historical changelog entries below.
  * Files: `aegis-brain.html` → `okf-brain.html`; skills/commands/prompts `aegis-discover` → `okf-discover` and `aegis-review` → `okf-review`; `aegis-okf.mdc` → `okf.mdc`; `aegis-okf.agent.md` → `okf.agent.md`; `aegis-capability-discovery.md` → `okf-capability-discovery.md`; `extending-aegis.md` → `extending-okf.md`; `maintain-aegis-system.md` → `maintain-okf-system.md`.
  * Code: `AEGIS_BRAIN_HTML` → `OKF_BRAIN_HTML`; `inject_into_aegis_brain` → `inject_into_okf_brain`.
  * Content: frontmatter tag `aegis-system` → `okf-system`; `pack_force_when` keywords `extend aegis` / `replicate aegis` → `extend okf` / `replicate okf`. Phrases that would have stuttered were collapsed by hand: "Aegis OKF" → "OKF", "Aegis Open Knowledge Format" → "Open Knowledge Format".
* **Removed `okf.py enrich` entirely.** It was the only consumer of the LLM transport, so this also deleted the outbound HTTP client, the SSRF endpoint/redirect validators, the bearer-token handling, the secret-scan egress guard, and the `OKF_LLM_*` environment surface. Vault content no longer leaves the machine through the kernel.
* **`okf.py serve` is now read-only.** Dropped `/api/lint` and `/api/compile` along with the per-run `X-OKF-Token`, the CSRF Origin gate, and the HTML token injection — with no mutate endpoints there is nothing to authenticate. The visualizer's Run Lint button now lints client-side; Run Compile is gone (use the CLI and reload). The loopback-only bind stays, as content containment rather than auth: `graph.json` embeds full document bodies.

* **Protocol 6.0.0 — token + retrieval overhaul.** Per-turn always-on context cut from ~5,550 to ~2,747 tokens (Cursor) and 1,027 → 688 (Copilot), and the mandated ritual from 4 round trips to 1.
* **Kernel:** Capability Discovery folded into `pack` as a one-line `caps:` header — Rule #1 is now a single command. `pack` always exits 0; an empty pack is a valid answer.
* **Fix (retrieval precision):** `pack_force_when` matched bare substrings, so `tab` fired on "table"/"stable" and `deploy` on "deployment", force-including unrelated cards at score 10,000. Now matches on token boundaries, with multi-word keywords requiring a contiguous phrase.
* **Fix (scoring):** description-only tokens were merged into the title and id bags, scoring an unrelated concept 83 on "how do I bake a cake". Per-field token bags are now separate and the any-field bonus dropped from 20 to 4.
* **Kernel:** Added a relevance floor (`--min-score`, default 24) so off-topic queries return nothing rather than a confident wrong card; token budget is now strictly enforced (oversized single cards are truncated).
* **Security:** `render_bench_report.py` no longer passes untrusted fragments through unescaped. (The `enrich` secret scan and the `serve` mutate-API token added here were superseded the same day — see above; both features were removed outright.)
* **Fix:** frontmatter parser now rejects YAML it cannot represent (block scalars, nested maps, anchors) instead of silently mangling it; strips inline comments. `known_types()` reads the house schema instead of scraping arbitrary AGENTS.md table rows.
* **Fix:** compile freshness check now validates `prompt_cards.json` and `graph.json`, not just `index.json`.
* **Tooling:** `.cursor/skills/` is the single source of truth; `tools/sync_skills.py` generates `.github/skills/` and CI gates drift. Deleted phantom parent workspace rules that pointed at a `knowledge/` tree which does not exist.
* **Tests:** added `tests/test_retrieval_quality.py` — precision, recall, ranking, budget, and force-match regression coverage.
